title: UI e UX, parte 4: Plano como uma fila

screens.title: Em seguida, uma fila
screens.why: Headed as Agora is; every task plays; events as on the calendar; it ends in + Adicionar.

pins.label: Heading
pins.text: Em seguida is a section heading, the same size as Agora and Pendentes, no longer a caption.

pins.label: Play on all
pins.text: Every task in the queue has the round play on its left; over an hour it asks first (3).

pins.label: Event, as on the calendar
pins.text: An event has the calendar's sand fill and its pin in the play's room, so titles line up; it is not carried.

pins.label: + Adicionar
pins.text: Up to four cards, then '+ Adicionar', tight under the last card, its + in line with the cards' edge: it writes a task right after the last one here.

pins.label: Composer (#81)
pins.text: The + opens #81's composer, built in this delivery: no agent bar on Plano.

screens.title: Carregar na fila
screens.why: Where it lands is the card itself, quiet; no 'Solte aqui'.

pins.label: Quiet copy
pins.text: The carried card's own copy at 40 %, name and length, opens where it would land; the cards under it make room.

pins.label: Old place closes
pins.text: Its place closes while held, as in a list being reordered. A drop is that place in the queue (move { index }).

pins.label: Every section
pins.text: Pendentes, Para depois and Agora draw the same copy, at their top (Agora: in place of what runs). No outline, no words.

screens.title: Play numa tarefa de 2h
screens.why: #83's sheet, now for any task over an hour, wherever play is.

pins.label: Any task
pins.text: Asked for a loose task too, from Em seguida, Pendentes, Para depois, the calendar or a drop on Agora.

pins.label: The rest waits
pins.text: A loose task's piece begins that long; the rest is a loose task in Pendentes owing what is left.

pins.label: 30 min first
pins.text: The smallest piece is the accent; 1 h and Tudo · 2h beside it.

pins.label: Talk
pins.text: Falar com a Lunna opens the conversation about the task.

screens.title: Ver o dia
screens.why: The calendar's Agora plays and pauses where every card does.

pins.label: Round play
pins.text: Agora's task: pause/play is the round button before the title, as on Plano; a waiting task begins from it.

pins.label: Quiet row
pins.text: −10, +10 and ✓ stay; the row's own pause is gone. An event keeps its row.

pins.label: Play on cards
pins.text: Each task not begun keeps its play; over an hour it asks (3).

pins.label: Bar goes
pins.text: The ask bar is replaced by the composer's + here too, with #81's build.
